name: scad-preview
description: Fast OpenSCAD preview with color, customizer, cross-sections and slice measurement.

scadPreview.openscadPath.markdownDescription: Path to the OpenSCAD executable or AppImage. When empty, the extension looks for an `OpenSCAD*.AppImage` in the workspace folder or any folder above it, then falls back to `openscad` on `PATH`.

scadPreview.defaultColor.markdownDescription: Color for parts without a `color()`, as `#RRGGBB`.

scadPreview.appearance.fontSize.markdownDescription: Text size of the preview's toolbar and panels, in px. `0` follows VS Code's font size (the panels use 10% more).

scadPreview.appearance.background.markdownDescription: Background of the 3D view, as `#RRGGBB`. Empty uses the editor's background.

scadPreview.appearance.codeMeasureColor.markdownDescription: Color of measurements from `echo("measure", …)` in the file.

scadPreview.appearance.measureLabelSize.markdownDescription: Text size of measurement labels on the model, in px.

scadPreview.appearance.highlightColor.markdownDescription: Color of `#` (highlight) parts. They are drawn see-through.

scadPreview.appearance.backgroundPartCol.markdownDescription: Color of `%` (background) parts. They are drawn faintly see-through.

scadPreview.layout.toolsSide.markdownDescription: Side for the Section and Measure panels. On the same side as Parameters, they sit next to it.

scadPreview.layout.toolsWidth.markdownDescription: Width of the Section and Measure panels, in px.

scadPreview.layout.parametersWidth.markdownDescription: Width of the Parameters panel, in px.

scadPreview.viewCube.corner.markdownDescription: Corner of the 3D view for the navigation cube and the axes.

scadPreview.viewCube.size.markdownDescription: Size of the navigation cube with its arrows, in px.

scadPreview.axes.show.markdownDescription: Show the X/Y/Z axes next to the navigation cube.

scadPreview.axes.size.markdownDescription: Size of the X/Y/Z axes, in px.

scadPreview.view.orthographic.markdownDescription: Open previews with an orthographic (no perspective) view.

scadPreview.view.edges.markdownDescription: Open previews with facet edges shown.

scadPreview.draftFn.markdownDescription: While a customizer slider is being dragged, render with `$fn` set to this for speed, then do one full render on release. `0` turns draft renders off.

scadPreview.unpackAppImage.markdownDescription: When OpenSCAD is an AppImage, unpack it once (about 300 MB, in VS Code's storage for this extension) and run the unpacked copy. Starting an AppImage costs about 0.3 s per run; the unpacked copy starts in about 0.05 s. Redone when the AppImage changes.

scadPreview.debugModifiers.markdownDescription: Show `#` (highlight) and `%` (background) parts. When the file or a file next to it uses them, a second pass runs after each full render, about as long as the render itself, and the parts appear when it finishes.
